text: やつらが　いきなり　やってきて　ビルを　のっとったんです

structure.jp: やつらが　いきなり　やってきて
structure.en: those guys suddenly showed up and

structure.jp: ビルを　のっとったんです
structure.en: took over the building, you see

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next, like 'and then'. やってきて　ビルを　のっとった = 'showed up and took over the building'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んです is the polite spoken form of のだ, which gives the sentence the feel of explaining what happened. のっとったんです = 'they took it over, you see'.
